test_deprecate_kwarg_rename: test the deprecate_kwarg decorator to rename a deprecated keyword argument to a new name
test_deprecate_kwarg_multiple: test stacking multiple deprecate_kwarg decorators to rename several deprecated keyword arguments at once
test_deprecate_kwarg_warnings: test that deprecate_kwarg raises FutureWarning when the deprecated argument is used with a future version
test_deprecate_kwarg_raises: test that deprecate_kwarg raises ValueError when both deprecated and new names are passed with raise_if_both_names
test_deprecate_kwarg_compile_safe: test that deprecate_kwarg decorated functions work correctly with torch.compile fullgraph mode
